blockrazor.documented_rule: Average gas price of a BSC bundle must be >= 0.05 gwei; mempool transactions are excluded from the average calculation.

fortyeightclub.observed: Current public documentation confirms eth_sendBundle, bundle size/rate limits, bundle status and priority behavior, but no current explicit minimum bundle gas-price floor was located.
fortyeightclub.rule: Do not arm DRY-3 from a stale 1-gwei assumption. Obtain a current explicit rule from 48Club endpoint/support or a reproducible dry prequalification before final signing.
